claim_boundary: This artifact proves only that tail-only projection telescopes to the Cycle-132 discrepancy and derives the exact paired-edge target. It proves no paired-tail bound, transition concentration, seed, endpoint, moment, density, or prime intervals.

remaining_target.statement: prove the fixed-difference paired-tail diagonal second moment at L=S/N or invert its excess into a phase-anchored chain

tail_coupled_transition_theorem.boundary: the paired-tail norm is not proved; no transition concentration, seed, endpoint, moment, density, or prime-interval theorem follows
tail_coupled_transition_theorem.edge_identity: for b=a+d, x_b-g^d x_a equals g^d*s_a/[q_a(R_a+theta_a q_a)] minus s_b/[q_b(R_b+theta_b q_b)] exactly
tail_coupled_transition_theorem.frequency_scale: after normalizing the edge residual by NS, theta changes it on scale N/S; resolving the tail requires frequency L=S/N, equivalently raw residual frequency S^2
tail_coupled_transition_theorem.marginal_no_gain: Fourier projection in theta alone therefore cancels only internal shear boundaries and reproduces the Cycle-132 logarithmic-center discrepancy; it yields no independent transition-entropy saving
tail_coupled_transition_theorem.paired_norm: the next proof target is the fixed-difference diagonal estimate sum_{|ell|<=L}|sum_{a in E_d} w_a e(ell Omega_d(a))|^2 << L|E_d|X^epsilon, where Omega_d=NS(x_{a+d}-g^d x_a) and L=S/N
tail_coupled_transition_theorem.tail_tiling: with Y=1/(q|alpha-p/q|) and R=r+tq, the conditions R<Y<R+q tile exactly over consecutive t; a complete shear block is one interval with only its two outer boundaries
